parameter_set.description: PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's Ramadass2004 parameter set, for a graphite/LCO cell, assembled from several papers (Ramadass et al. 2004 and others). Exported to BPX by battinfo-records (scripts/export-pybamm-bpx.py).

notes: Parameter values from https://doi.org/10.1149/1.1634273 as implemented in PyBaMM's Ramadass2004 parameter set (PyBaMM 26.10.1.1, BSD-3-Clause), exported to BPX by battinfo-records.
Matches PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's native set within 0.38 mV RMS and 0.01% capacity (DFN discharges at 0.2C, 1C, 2C and 1C 20 K warmer).
The cell surface area and volume are not in the PyBaMM set. They are derived from the electrode stack, and only thermal models use them.
